column1: # tools/doom/core-initials-held.tsv -- stored fields Full would carry but does
# A stored, non-scratch field takes `initial prepared:NAME` -- Full reads its
# pre-tick value off the objects it constructs -- when the audit has no initial
# for it (UNDERIVED) or when Full's setup writes it after allocating it
# (setup-writes.tsv). A row here keeps the schema's fill for such a field, and
# that fill is NOT a claim about the original: every row is a field whose
# declared shape the original does not have, so there is no correct length to
# carry. tests/doom-core/state.sh checks this set, by name, against the
# reference's shape refusals and the fields the audit has no count for.
